title: Santa Ponsa – H10 Casa del Mar (Bed And Breakfast
naziv: Santa Ponsa – H10 Casa del Mar (Bed And Breakfast)

sa_sajta.opis: Paket H10 Casa del Mar - Majorka - Santa Ponsa
sa_sajta.tekst:
This hotel is just across the road from from the beach approximately 300 m from the centre of Santa Ponsa. There are shops, restaurants, bars and pubs in close proximity to the hotel and it is just 200 m to public transport connections. There is a nightclub just 300 m from the hotel.
The hotel was built in 1975. Travellers can feel at home in one of the 212 rooms. In the air-conditioned establishment, guests are welcomed at the reception area with 24-hour reception and a 24-hour check-in/check-out service. Most of the storeys can be reached by lift. Amenities include a safe and a currency exchange service. Wireless internet access is available to travellers in the public areas. Among the culinary options available at the accommodation are a restaurant and a bar. The grounds of the hotel feature a playground and an attractive garden. Additional facilities at the establishment include a TV room. Guests arriving by car can leave their vehicles in the garage or in the car park. Available services and facilities include multilingual staff, a childcare service, medical assistance, room service, a wake-up service and a laundry service. Active guests can make use of the bicycle hire service to explore the surrounding area.
